titleZh: 驯鹿飞行学校圣诞贺卡

title: Marshmallow Hot Tub Christmas Card
prompt: A kawaii style printable Christmas card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The view is a top-down perspective looking into a red ceramic mug filled with rich, brown hot chocolate. titleZh: 棉花糖热水浴缸圣诞贺卡
promptZh: 一张可爱风格的可打印圣诞贺卡插画，宽高比为 1:1.4。视角是俯视一个装满浓郁棕色热巧克力的红色陶瓷马克杯。杯子里，三个可爱的白色棉花糖角色正在放松，仿佛在泡热水澡。一个棉花糖向后靠着，戴着巧克力糖霜画的墨镜。另一个戴着一个迷你拐杖糖呼吸管。第三个则像木筏一样漂浮在一块巧克力棒上。蒸汽呈心形向上缭绕。马克杯外的背景是柔和的粉色，上面有白色波点。高分辨率，色彩鲜艳，矢量艺术风格。

title: Hamster with Cranberry Christmas Card
prompt: An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card illustration in a soft, storybook watercolor style, aspect ratio 1:1.4. titleZh: 带蔓越莓的仓鼠圣诞卡
promptZh: 一张精致的、可打印的圣诞贺卡插画，采用柔和的童话水彩风格，长宽比为 1:1.4。画面特写了一只胖乎乎的金棕色仓鼠，它戴着一顶小巧的红色针织圣诞帽。仓鼠坐在一张用冰棒棍做成的迷你木桌旁。它用两只爪子捧着一颗鲜红的蔓越莓，两颊塞得鼓鼓的，看起来非常开心。桌上有一个顶针充当的杯子，还有一个放着一小块奶酪的迷你盘子。背景是温暖的奶油色米白纸张纹理，角落里有淡淡的水彩冬青叶。整体氛围温馨、小巧、暖心。

titleZh: 圣诞灯饰中的猫咪圣诞贺卡

title: Snowman and Birds on Park Bench
prompt:
A beautiful and charming winter illustration, perfect for a printable greeting card. A friendly snowman with a carrot nose, coal eyes, and a smile sits on a weathered green wooden park bench partially covered in soft snow. The snowman is dressed in a dark brown fedora and a warm red and yellow patterned scarf, with twig arms resting on the bench.

A vibrant red cardinal is perched on the back of the bench. Next to the snowman sits a small burlap sack overflowing with birdseed. Several cute black-capped chickadees are happily eating seeds on the bench and on the snowy ground in the foreground.

The background shows a serene, snowy landscape with a forest of pine trees under a pale, overcast sky with large, soft snowflakes gently falling. The entire scene has a soft, painterly texture with a gentle, embossed quality, creating a heartwarming and peaceful mood.

High detail, intricate, beautiful illustration, printable quality. --ar 1:1.4
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 公园长凳上的雪人和鸟儿
promptZh:
一幅美丽迷人的冬季插画，非常适合制作可打印的贺卡。一个友善的雪人，长着胡萝卜鼻子、煤炭眼睛和微笑，坐在一张部分被柔软积雪覆盖的、饱经风霜的绿色木质公园长椅上。雪人戴着一顶深棕色软呢帽，围着一条温暖的红黄相间图案围巾，树枝手臂搭在长椅上。

一只鲜红的北美红雀栖息在长椅的靠背上。雪人旁边放着一个装满鸟食的小麻袋。几只可爱的黑顶山雀正在长椅上和前景的雪地上愉快地吃着鸟食。

背景是一片宁静的雪景，松树林在苍白多云的天空下，大片柔软的雪花轻轻飘落。整个场景呈现出柔和的绘画质感和轻微的浮雕效果，营造出一种温馨宁静的氛围。

高细节，精致，精美插画，可打印质量。--ar 1:1.4

title: Navy Blue Silver Filigree Card
prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas greeting card design, flat vector art style, with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The background is a solid, deep navy blue.

In the center, the words Merry Christmas are written in an elegant, flowing white script font.

The text is surrounded by delicate, symmetrical filigree swirls and flourishes in light blue and silvery-gray. These decorative vines are adorned with stylized silver-gray leaves and small dots like winter berries or snow, also in light blue and silver. The overall design is clean, minimalist, and sophisticated with a cool winter color palette. High resolution, sharp lines, elegant graphic illustration.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 海军蓝银丝花纹卡片
promptZh:
一张精美的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，采用扁平矢量艺术风格，长宽比为 1:1.4。背景是纯色深海军蓝。

title: Charcoal Folk Art Botanical Card
prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas card design, presented in a frontal view.
The background is a solid dark charcoal gray with a matte paper texture.

In the center, the greeting Merry Christmas is elegantly hand-lettered in a flowing white brush script.
The text is beautifully framed by a dense, hand-painted border of festive botanicals in a charming folk art style. This border features stylized red poinsettia flowers, dark green holly leaves with red berries, pine sprigs, and clusters of golden-yellow berries.

Light teal leafy vines are woven throughout the arrangement, providing a modern and colorful contrast. Small, simple red hearts are tucked into the design, adding a touch of warmth.

The illustration has a flat, 2D gouache on paper look, with opaque colors and a delightful handcrafted feel.

Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 炭笔民间艺术植物卡片
promptZh:
一张精美的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，正面视图。
背景是纯深炭灰色，带有哑光纸张纹理。

贺卡中央，问候语“圣诞快乐”以流畅的白色手写笔触优雅呈现。
文字被一圈浓密的、手绘的节日植物边框精美地环绕，呈现出迷人的民间艺术风格。这个边框描绘了风格化的红色一品红花朵、带有红色浆果的深绿色冬青叶、松枝以及簇状的金黄色浆果。

花环中央，用大号流畅的红色草书字体写着问候语 Merry Christmas。下方，单词 AND 以简洁的无衬线大写字体居中，两侧是两条细细的红色水平线。最后的祝福语 HAPPY NEW YEAR! 则以相同的红色无衬线字体写在下方。

整体美学风格简洁、喜庆、温馨，具有扁平的图形插画质感。

title: Retro 1950s Christmas City Street
prompt:
A vibrant and exquisite 1950s retro Christmas card illustration in a flat graphic style. The scene depicts a bustling city street at night, with a light dusting of snow on the ground and gentle snowflakes falling. In the background, a row of mid-century and Art Deco buildings glow with colorful, festive neon signs for a 'Kringle's DEPARTMENT STORE', 'Starlight DINER', a theater named 'COMET', and a shop called 'Hollys'. The department store features a large display window with a decorated white Christmas tree surrounded by toys.

The sidewalks are filled with cheerful shoppers in 1950s winter fashion, carrying gifts and shopping bags. In the upper right sky, a large, glowing full moon shines as Santa's sleigh and reindeer fly past in silhouette.

In the foreground, a classic red and cream 1950s station wagon is parked, its interior filled with colorfully wrapped presents. A couple with two small black dogs walks on the sidewalk, holding more gifts. Further down the street, a yellow taxi carries a Christmas tree on its roof. On the right, a red A-frame sign on the sidewalk displays the message 'Happy HOLIDAYS'. The overall atmosphere is festive and nostalgic, with a rich color palette of deep blues, reds, and greens. Printable quality, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 复古 1950 年代圣诞城市街道
promptZh:
一幅生动精致的 20 世纪 50 年代复古圣诞贺卡插画，采用扁平图形风格。画面描绘了夜晚熙熙攘攘的城市街道，地面上覆盖着一层薄薄的雪，雪花轻轻飘落。背景中，一排中世纪和装饰艺术风格的建筑闪烁着五彩缤纷的节日霓虹灯，上面写着“Kringle's 百货商店”、“Starlight DINER”餐厅、一家名为“COMET”的剧院和一家名为“Hollys”的商店。百货商店的橱窗里展示着一棵装饰精美的白色圣诞树，周围摆满了玩具。

人行道上挤满了身着 20 世纪 50 年代冬季时装、提着礼物和购物袋的欢快购物者。右上方的天空中，一轮巨大的、发光的满月高悬，圣诞老人的雪橇和驯鹿以剪影的形式飞过。

前景中停放着一辆经典的红白相间 20 世纪 50 年代旅行车，车内装满了五颜六色的包装好的礼物。一对夫妇带着两只小黑狗走在人行道上，手里拿着更多的礼物。街道的远处，一辆黄色出租车车顶载着一棵圣诞树。右侧人行道上有一个红色的 A 形标志，上面写着“Happy HOLIDAYS”。整体氛围充满节日气息和怀旧感，色彩丰富，以深蓝色、红色和绿色为主。可打印质量，长宽比 1:1.4。

title: Victorian Santa on Rooftop Balcony
prompt:
A vintage Victorian Christmas card illustration featuring a cheerful Santa Claus on a snowy rooftop balcony at night, overlooking a quaint village. Santa is a portly figure with a full white beard and rosy cheeks, dressed in a classic red suit with white fur trim and a black belt. He is blowing a small brass horn and holding a dark wooden walking stick.

A large wicker basket filled with old-fashioned toys, including a small fir tree and a drum, is visible on his back. To the left, part of a large clock tower face with Roman numerals is seen. Santa stands behind an ornate, snow-covered stone balustrade with intricate gothic carvings.

In the background, the cozy village has steep, snow-covered roofs and windows glowing with warm light. The night sky is a deep blue, with soft, heavy snowfall covering the entire scene.

At the top, the greeting Merry Christmas is written in a decorative, vintage font, appearing as if formed from snow on a dark eave.

The artwork has the textured feel of a classic chromolithograph print on aged paper, with a rich, slightly faded color palette. The style is nostalgic, festive, and magical.

Exquisite and highly detailed, printable quality, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 维多利亚风格的圣诞老人在屋顶阳台
promptZh:
一张复古维多利亚风格的圣诞贺卡插画，描绘了圣诞老人在夜晚白雪覆盖的屋顶阳台上，俯瞰着一个古朴的村庄。圣诞老人身材丰满，留着浓密的白胡子，脸颊红润，身穿经典的红色套装，镶有白色毛边，系着黑色腰带。他正在吹奏一支小铜号，手里拿着一根深色木制手杖。

他背上有一个大柳条筐，里面装满了老式玩具，包括一棵小枞树和一个鼓。左侧可以看到一个带有罗马数字的大钟楼的一部分。圣诞老人站在一个华丽的、被雪覆盖的石制栏杆后面，栏杆上雕刻着精美的哥特式图案。

背景中，温馨的村庄屋顶陡峭，覆盖着白雪，窗户透出温暖的光芒。夜空深蓝，鹅毛大雪轻轻飘落，覆盖了整个场景。

顶部，问候语 Merry Christmas 以装饰性的复古字体书写，仿佛由黑暗屋檐上的雪花形成。

这幅艺术作品具有经典彩色石版印刷品在旧纸上的质感，色彩丰富，略显褪色。风格怀旧、喜庆、充满魔力。

精致且高度细致，可打印质量，长宽比 1:1.4。

title: Layered Papercraft Cutout Tree
prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design in a layered papercraft and die-cut style, presented in a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The card features a vibrant red textured paper background with faint, soft-edged light red polka dots.

In the center, a stylized Christmas tree is created as a cutout, revealing different green patterned layers beneath. The tree is composed of four stacked sections, topped with a simple yellow star. From top to bottom, the green sections have different designs: solid light green, medium green with white polka dots, medium green with white dashed stitch lines, and darker green with white wavy lines.

Flanking the middle of the tree are two intricate, white, die-cut snowflakes with a subtle drop shadow. The top and bottom borders of the card are adorned with elegant white paper cutout swirls and filigree, creating a decorative frame.

At the bottom, the text Merry Christmas is written in a beautiful white script font, also designed with a cutout effect and a slight shadow to give it depth. The entire composition is clean and graphic, with a charming handmade feel due to the layered paper effect.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 分层纸艺镂空树
promptZh:
一张精致的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，采用分层剪纸和模切风格，比例为 1:1.4。贺卡以鲜艳的红色纹理纸为背景，上面点缀着淡淡的、柔和边缘的浅红色波点。

卡片中央是一棵风格化的圣诞树，采用镂空设计，露出下方不同图案的绿色分层。这棵树由四层堆叠而成，顶部是一颗简单的黄色星星。从上到下，绿色部分有不同的设计：纯浅绿色、带有白色波点的中绿色、带有白色虚线缝合线的中绿色，以及带有白色波浪线的深绿色。

圣诞树中部两侧是两片精致的白色模切雪花，带有微妙的阴影效果。贺卡的顶部和底部边框装饰着优雅的白色剪纸漩涡和花丝，形成一个装饰性边框。

底部是文字 Merry Christmas，以美丽的白色手写字体书写，也设计成镂空效果，并带有轻微的阴影以增加立体感。整个构图简洁而富有图形感，分层纸艺效果赋予其迷人的手工质感。

title: Cute Doodle Reindeer Face

title: Vintage Sledding Children
prompt:

The scene features two joyful children, a boy and a girl, sledding together down a gentle, snow-covered hill. The boy in front, wearing a red pointed hat and a white patterned shirt, steers a traditional wooden sled with ornate, curved runners. The blonde girl sits behind him, wearing a white dotted bonnet, a red jacket, and a purple skirt, smiling warmly as she holds on.

The background shows a quaint winter forest with snow-dusted trees. The foreground includes the corner of a rustic log structure on the right and soft snow with sled tracks. The entire illustration has a nostalgic, warm feel, with delicate gold foil accents on the children's clothing and the sled.

At the bottom, elegant gold cursive lettering reads Fröhliche Weihnachten.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 复古雪橇儿童
promptZh:
一张精美的可打印复古圣诞明信片，采用经典的彩色石版画插画风格，宽高比为 1:1.4。

画面中，两个快乐的孩子——一个男孩和一个女孩——正一起乘坐雪橇滑下一个平缓的、白雪覆盖的小山。男孩在前，戴着一顶红色尖帽，穿着一件白色图案衬衫，操控着一辆带有华丽弧形滑板的传统木制雪橇。金发女孩坐在他身后，戴着一顶白色圆点软帽，穿着一件红色夹克和一条紫色裙子，她微笑着紧紧抓住雪橇。

背景是古朴的冬日森林，树木上覆盖着薄薄的雪。前景右侧有一个乡村原木建筑的角落，以及带有雪橇痕迹的柔软积雪。整幅插画散发着怀旧而温馨的气息，孩子们的衣服和雪橇上点缀着精致的金色箔片。

底部是优雅的金色草书文字：Fröhliche Weihnachten。

title: Humorous Santa on North Pole Sign
prompt:

The scene features a cheeky cartoon Santa Claus playfully clinging to a red-and-white striped candy cane pole, which stands in a snowy landscape. Santa is smiling and winking, wearing his classic red suit, hat, and black boots. At the top of the pole is a small wooden sign pointing left with the words "NORTH POLE".

The background is a vibrant teal-blue sky with soft, falling snow particles creating a wintery feel. The ground is covered in simple mounds of white snow with light blue shading.

On the left side of the card, text is arranged vertically. At the top, in a simple black sans-serif font, are the words "I got". Below this, the phrase "Ho Ho Ho's" is written in a playful, bold font with each word in a different color. 贺卡左侧的文字垂直排列。顶部是简单的黑色无衬线字体，写着“I got”。下方，“Ho Ho Ho's" 这句话以俏皮、粗体的字体书写，每个词都采用不同的颜色。再下方，短语的最后一部分“In Different Area Codes" 垂直堆叠，字体与顶行相同，均为黑色。

prompt:

author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 复古中世纪灯饰与花环
promptZh:

顶部悬挂着一条喜庆的绿色冬青花环，上面点缀着红色浆果，中央系着一个大大的红色蝴蝶结。一串色彩缤纷的复古风格圣诞彩灯，红、金黄、绿三色，用细细的黑线从花环上垂下。

整体美学风格简洁、图形化，充满迷人的怀旧气息，采用扁平矢量艺术风格。

title: Vintage Shushing Santa at Night
prompt:
A beautiful, printable vintage Christmas card illustration in a classic, painterly style, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The scene depicts a magical winter night in a quaint village. A jolly Santa Claus is the central figure, dressed in his traditional red suit with white fur trim, shushing with a finger to his lips. He carries a large green sack filled with presents over his shoulder.

To his left, a cheerful snowman with a carrot nose, a red scarf, and a small hat stands beside an ornate, old-fashioned lamppost. The lamppost is lit, casting a warm, golden glow on the snow, and is decorated with a festive wreath and a large red bow. A small, wrapped gift sits in the snow at the base of the snowman.

Heavy, soft snowflakes fall from a deep blue night sky, blanketing the scene and the village houses in the background, whose windows glow warmly. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, nostalgic, and full of holiday spirit.

In the upper right corner, the text is written in an elegant, white cursive script: Happy Holidays.

titleZh: 夜幕下的复古嘘声圣诞老人
promptZh:
一张精美的、可打印的复古圣诞贺卡插画，采用经典的绘画风格，长宽比为 1:1.4。

画面描绘了一个古朴村庄里神奇的冬夜。一位和蔼可亲的圣诞老人是中心人物，他身穿传统的红色套装，镶有白色毛边，一根手指放在嘴唇上，示意大家安静。他肩上扛着一个装满礼物的绿色大袋子。

在他的左边，一个欢快的雪人，长着胡萝卜鼻子，戴着红色围巾和小帽子，站在一盏华丽的老式路灯旁。路灯亮着，在雪地上投下温暖的金黄色光芒，并装饰着一个节日花环和一个大红色蝴蝶结。雪人脚下雪地里放着一个用包装纸包好的小礼物。

深蓝色的夜空中飘落着厚厚的、柔软的雪花，覆盖了整个场景和背景中的村庄房屋，房屋的窗户透出温暖的光芒。整体氛围宁静、怀旧，充满了节日气息。

在右上角，用优雅的白色草书写着文字：Happy Holidays。

title: Whimsical Woodland Animal Gathering
prompt:
An exquisite and printable watercolor illustration for a holiday greeting card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The style is charming, whimsical, and storybook-like, with a soft, gentle color palette.

The scene depicts a cheerful gathering of forest animals in a snowy winter woodland during a light snowfall. In the center, a beautifully decorated Christmas tree is adorned with red ornaments, snowflake cutouts, cookie stars, pinecones, and a rustic twig star on top.

A large black bear, wearing a Santa hat and a cozy red scarf, stands on its hind legs admiring the tree. A small bear cub next to it, wearing a green scarf, waves joyfully. To the left, a graceful doe wears a holly wreath with a large red and white striped bow, and a tiny, cute white owl with a red scarf sits on her back. In front of them, a small fawn with a Santa hat lies peacefully in the snow.

To the right, another large black bear with a Santa hat and a festive evergreen wreath around its neck walks forward, carrying a small cub in a red knitted hat on its back. The foreground features an adorable raccoon in a Santa hat holding a snowflake, a squirrel, a quail, and several bright red cardinals.

The background consists of soft, muted evergreen and bare birch trees, where more birds, including owls in festive scarves and cardinals, are perched on the branches. The entire scene has a soft watercolor texture on paper.

In the top left corner, the text 'Happy Holidays!' is written in an elegant, flowing red cursive script.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 奇思妙想的林地动物聚会
promptZh:
一张精美可打印的水彩插画，用于节日贺卡，宽高比为 1:1.4。风格迷人、奇趣、富有童话色彩，色调柔和、温婉。

画面描绘了白雪皑皑的冬日林地，小雪纷飞，一群森林动物正在欢快地聚会。画面中央是一棵装饰精美的圣诞树，上面挂满了红色饰品、雪花剪纸、饼干星星、松果，树顶则是一颗质朴的树枝星星。

一只戴着圣诞帽、围着舒适红围巾的大黑熊，后腿站立，欣赏着圣诞树。旁边的小熊宝宝戴着绿围巾，欢快地挥舞着爪子。左侧，一只优雅的母鹿戴着一个带有红白条纹大蝴蝶结的冬青花环，一只戴着红围巾的娇小可爱白猫头鹰坐在它的背上。它们前方，一只戴着圣诞帽的小鹿安静地躺在雪中。

右侧，另一只戴着圣诞帽、脖子上挂着节日常青花环的大黑熊正向前走，背上驮着一只戴着红色针织帽的小熊宝宝。前景中有一只戴着圣诞帽、手持雪花的可爱浣熊、一只松鼠、一只鹌鹑和几只鲜红的北美红雀。

背景是柔和、低调的常青树和光秃秃的桦树，更多的鸟儿，包括戴着节日围巾的猫头鹰和北美红雀，栖息在树枝上。整个画面呈现出柔和的水彩纸质感。

左上角用优雅流畅的红色草书字体写着文字“Happy Holidays!”。

title: Magical Glowing Forest and Snowman
prompt:

titleZh: 神奇发光森林与雪人

titleZh: 北极光下的北极熊
promptZh:
一张充满奇思妙想、引人入胜的圣诞贺卡插画，描绘了一只北极熊妈妈和她的幼崽。它们站在左下方一块小小的淡蓝色浮冰上，仰望着神奇的夜空，眼中充满了惊奇。

夜空呈现出美丽的画作般的渐变色，从深海军蓝到鲜艳的青绿色，并带有柔和的紫色北极光效果。夜空中，右上角有一颗巨大的、光芒四射的金色伯利恒之星，周围环绕着较小的金色星星和精致的雪花状白色星星。

海洋是深沉的暗蓝色，底部有水平的笔触和闪烁的星光倒影。

左上角，用优雅的金色草书写着“Merry Christmas”。

这幅艺术作品采用迷人的水彩和水粉风格，具有可见的纹理和温暖人心的感觉。细节丰富，精美，可直接用于印刷。长宽比为 1:1.4。

title: Trio of Gingerbread Cookies
prompt:
A charming and humorous Christmas card design in a flat vector illustration style. The scene features three cute gingerbread men cookies standing in a horizontal row against a plain white background.

From left to right: the first gingerbread cookie is a girl, smiling happily with an open mouth, decorated with two pink heart buttons and a sprig of holly on her head. The middle gingerbread man wears a red Santa hat and a matching red scarf, with green buttons and a cheerful smile. The third gingerbread man has a shocked expression with a round open mouth, wearing a red and green bowtie, with a large bite taken out of his leg and crumbs falling.

Below the cookies, the text reads HO HO OH ... in a simple, handwritten font.

The design is clean, with bold outlines and a festive color palette of brown, red, green, and pink. Exquisite and printable quality, 1:1.4 aspect ratio.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 姜饼曲奇三件套
promptZh:
一个迷人又幽默的圣诞贺卡设计，采用扁平矢量插画风格。画面中，三个可爱的姜饼小人饼干并排站立在纯白色背景前。

从左到右：第一个姜饼小人是女孩，她张着嘴巴开心地笑着，身上装饰着两颗粉色心形纽扣，头上戴着一小枝冬青。中间的姜饼小人戴着一顶红色圣诞帽和一条配套的红色围巾，身上有绿色纽扣，笑容愉快。第三个姜饼小人表情震惊，嘴巴张成圆形，戴着红绿相间的领结，腿上被咬掉一大块，碎屑正在往下掉。

饼干下方，文字写着 HO HO OH ...，字体简洁，呈手写风格。

设计简洁，轮廓大胆，色彩搭配充满节日气氛，包括棕色、红色、绿色和粉色。品质精美，可打印，宽高比为 1:1.4。

title: Luxurious Black and Gold Corporate Card
prompt:
An elegant and luxurious Christmas and New Year greeting card design, presented as a flat graphic, high resolution and perfect for printing. The design features a deep black background scattered with fine golden glitter dust and soft bokeh lights.

Large, intricate snowflakes with a sparkling gold glitter texture cascade down from the top of the card, creating a beautiful, festive border. In the center, the text "merry" is rendered in a flowing, handwritten gold glitter script, followed by "CHRISTMAS" in a bold, embossed gold serif font. Below this, the phrase "and Happy New Year." is written in a delicate, thin gold script.

Positioned towards the bottom is a horizontal rectangular block with a brushed gold foil finish. Inside this block, feature the custom text: Crestline ENTERTAINMENT, INC. in a simple black font.

The overall aesthetic is sophisticated and celebratory, with a strong contrast between the black and the glittering gold. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 奢华黑金企业卡
promptZh:
这是一款优雅奢华的圣诞和新年贺卡设计，以平面图形呈现，高分辨率，非常适合印刷。设计采用深黑色背景，点缀着细密的金色闪粉和柔和的散景光斑。

大而精致的雪花，带有闪亮的金色闪粉纹理，从卡片顶部倾泻而下，营造出美丽、喜庆的边框。卡片中央，“merry”一词以流畅的手写金色闪粉字体呈现，随后是粗体浮雕金色衬线字体书写的“CHRISTMAS”。下方是“and Happy New Year.”，以精致纤细的金色字体书写。

底部是一个带有拉丝金箔饰面的水平矩形块。在此块内，以简单的黑色字体显示自定义文本：Crestline ENTERTAINMENT, INC.。

整体美学精致而富有庆祝氛围，黑色与闪烁的金色形成强烈对比。长宽比 1:1.4。

title: Watercolor Santa with Copy Space
prompt:
A beautiful watercolor Christmas illustration, in a whimsical and heartwarming style.
On the right side of the frame, a jolly cartoon Santa Claus waves cheerfully, standing in soft snow. Next to him is a tall, festive Christmas tree adorned with glowing lights, colorful baubles, and a shining star on top. Several wrapped gifts in red paper with gold bows sit at the base of the tree.

The background is a dreamy, abstract watercolor wash, transitioning from a deep teal-blue at the top to a warm, golden glow that radiates from behind the tree. A large, soft, light-colored area is left on the upper left, providing ample copy space.

Delicate snowflakes and soft white dots gently fall throughout the scene, creating a magical, snowy winter atmosphere. The entire artwork has a visible paper texture with soft, blended colors.

High resolution, intricate details, printable festive art. --ar 10:14
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 水彩圣诞老人与文案空间
promptZh:
一幅精美的水彩圣诞插画，风格奇特而温馨。
画面右侧，一个笑容可掬的卡通圣诞老人站在柔软的雪中，开心地挥着手。他身旁是一棵高大、充满节日气氛的圣诞树，上面装饰着闪烁的灯光、五彩的圣诞球和一颗闪亮的星星。树根处放着几个用红色纸和金色蝴蝶结包装的礼物。

背景是梦幻般的抽象水彩晕染，从顶部的深青蓝色过渡到树后散发出的温暖金色光芒。左上方留有一大片柔和的浅色区域，提供了充足的文案空间。

精致的雪花和柔和的白点轻轻飘落在整个场景中，营造出一种神奇的雪域冬季氛围。整幅作品具有明显的纸张纹理和柔和、融合的色彩。

高分辨率，细节精致，可打印的节日艺术。--ar 10:14

title: Minimalist Watercolor Festive Fox
prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The card features a beautiful watercolor illustration of a red fox against a clean, solid white background. The fox is the central focus, depicted from the chest up in a seated position, with its head turned slightly to the side, casting a gentle, downward gaze.

The artwork is rendered in a detailed yet soft watercolor style, capturing the rich texture of the fox's vibrant orange and fluffy white fur. Adorning the fox's head is a delicate festive arrangement of green holly leaves, bright red berries, and miniature pinecones. The overall design is elegant, artistic, and heartwarming, with a clean and minimalist feel that highlights the charm of the illustration.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 极简水彩节日狐狸
promptZh:
一张精致的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，长宽比为 1:1.4。

贺卡上是一幅美丽的红狐水彩插画，背景为简洁的纯白色。红狐是画面的中心焦点，以坐姿描绘其胸部以上的部分，头部略微侧转，目光温柔地向下凝视。

这幅作品以细腻而柔和的水彩风格呈现，捕捉了红狐鲜艳的橙色和蓬松的白色皮毛的丰富质感。红狐的头部装饰着精致的节日花束，包括绿色的冬青叶、鲜红的浆果和迷你松果。整体设计优雅、艺术且温馨，同时又具有简洁和极简主义的感觉，突出了插画的魅力。

title: Humorous 'Oh Snap' Gingerbread Man
prompt:
A printable, high-quality holiday greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The card features a minimalist and humorous illustration on a solid white background. In the center is a cartoon gingerbread man, tilted diagonally as if he's fallen. He has a surprised expression with wide black dot eyes. A large bite is taken out of the side of his head, with small white crumbs visible. The gingerbread man is a warm brown color with a subtle, crackled cookie texture and has one simple red circle for a cheek.

Above the gingerbread man, the text 'Oh, Snap!' is written in a casual, handwritten red font.
Below the gingerbread man, the text 'HAPPY HOLIDAYS' is written in a similar red, all-caps handwritten font.

The overall style is a clean, flat vector illustration with a playful and witty feel.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 幽默的“哦，天哪”姜饼人
promptZh:
一张可打印的高质量节日贺卡设计，长宽比为 1:1.4。

贺卡以纯白色背景为底，上面有一个极简而幽默的插画。画面中央是一个卡通姜饼人，倾斜着，仿佛刚摔倒。它表情惊讶，眼睛是两个大大的黑点。姜饼人的头部侧面被咬掉了一大块，露出细小的白色碎屑。姜饼人呈暖棕色，带有微妙的饼干裂纹质感，脸颊上只有一个简单的红色圆圈。

姜饼人上方，文字“Oh, Snap!”以随意的红色手写字体呈现。
姜饼人下方，文字“HAPPY HOLIDAYS”以类似的红色全大写手写字体呈现。

整体风格是简洁、扁平的矢量插画，带有俏皮幽默的感觉。

title: Cute Watercolor Penguins in Snow
prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas card design, minimalist and charming, with an aspect ratio of 1:1.4.

The background is a solid, soft, muted teal-blue color.
At the bottom of the card, there's a watercolor illustration of two adorable baby penguins standing on a patch of white snow. The penguin on the right is wearing a small red Santa hat with a white trim and pom-pom. The penguin on the left has its flippers spread wide in a joyful gesture, tossing a delicate spray of white snow into the air. The illustration is done in a soft watercolor style, primarily using shades of grey, black, and white, with a touch of red for the hat.

In the upper-middle area of the card, centered, is the text MERRY CHRISTMAS written in a clean, elegant, all-caps serif font.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 雪地里可爱的水彩企鹅
promptZh:
一张精美、可打印的圣诞贺卡设计，简约而迷人，长宽比为 1:1.4。

背景是纯色、柔和、低饱和度的青蓝色。
贺卡底部有一幅水彩插画，描绘了两只可爱的小企鹅站在一片白雪上。右边的企鹅戴着一顶带白色边饰和绒球的小红圣诞帽。左边的企鹅双鳍张开，做出欢快的姿势，向空中扬起一小片洁白的雪花。插画采用柔和的水彩风格，主要使用灰色、黑色和白色调，帽子部分点缀了一抹红色。

贺卡中上部居中位置是文字 MERRY CHRISTMAS，采用简洁、优雅的全大写衬线字体。

title: Scandinavian Navy and Cream Folk Art
prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas card design in a Scandinavian folk art style, featuring a symmetrical composition. Two stylized, elegant reindeer in a creamy off-white color face each other. Centered between their ornate antlers is a decorated Christmas tree.

The entire design is set against a solid dark navy blue background. The scene is densely filled with intricate folk art patterns, including cream-white flowers, leafy sprigs, hanging Christmas baubles, and twinkling four-pointed stars.

The artwork is a flat, 2D vector illustration with clean, crisp lines and a limited two-color palette of navy blue and off-white. The overall aesthetic is charming, festive, and intricate, perfect for a high-quality print. --ar 1:1.4
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 斯堪的纳维亚海军蓝和米色民间艺术
promptZh:
一张精美的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，采用斯堪的纳维亚民间艺术风格，构图对称。两只风格化、优雅的驯鹿呈奶油米白色，彼此相对。它们华丽的鹿角之间居中是一棵装饰过的圣诞树。

整个设计以纯深海军蓝色为背景。场景中密布着复杂的民间艺术图案，包括奶油白色的花朵、带叶的嫩枝、悬挂的圣诞彩球和闪烁的四角星。

这幅艺术作品是扁平的 2D 矢量插图，线条干净利落，仅使用海军蓝和米白两种颜色。整体美学风格迷人、喜庆且精致，非常适合高质量印刷。--ar 1:1.4

title: Minimalist Navy String Lights Card
prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
The design features horizontal strings of festive lights against a solid deep navy blue background.

The Christmas light bulbs have a charming watercolor texture in a palette of bright red, soft pink, and mint green. The strings are a delicate, looping, hand-drawn gold line.

In the center, the text merry christmas is written in a single, elegant, flowing gold cursive script, seamlessly integrated as part of the string light pattern.

The overall style is flat, graphic, minimalist, and heartwarming.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 极简海军蓝串灯卡片
promptZh:
一张精美的可打印圣诞贺卡设计，长宽比为 1:1.4。

设计特色是在纯深海军蓝色背景上，横向排列着一串串节日彩灯。

圣诞灯泡呈现迷人的水彩纹理，色彩包括亮红色、柔和的粉色和薄荷绿色。灯串是精致、环绕的手绘金色线条。

卡片中央，文字 merry christmas 以优雅流畅的金色草书字体书写，巧妙地融入灯串图案之中。

整体风格扁平、图形化、极简主义且温馨。

title: Funny Injured Gingerbread Man
prompt:
A beautiful and funny printable Christmas card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The card features a clean, minimalist cartoon illustration of a happy gingerbread man, viewed from the front. The gingerbread man is missing one leg and is cheerfully waving with one arm. A red and white striped candy cane is stuck into the white ground where his leg should be, humorously used as a crutch.

The gingerbread man has a simple smiling face, purple icing buttons, and a wavy white icing line on his chest. Tiny brown cookie crumbs are scattered on the ground near the broken leg stump and the base of the candy cane.

The illustration is set against a solid white background, with a subtle, soft light-blue watercolor wash just behind the character to make it pop.

Below the illustration, the phrase CHEERS TO SURVIVING THE SEASON is written in a black, quirky, informal, all-caps, hand-lettered font.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 受伤的搞笑姜饼人
promptZh:
一个精美有趣的圣诞贺卡设计，可打印，长宽比为 1:1.4。

贺卡上有一个简洁、极简的卡通插画，画着一个快乐的姜饼人，正面视角。姜饼人少了一条腿，正愉快地挥舞着一只手臂。一根红白相间的拐杖糖插在他本该是腿的白色地面上，幽默地充当拐杖。

姜饼人有着简单的笑脸、紫色的糖霜纽扣和胸前波浪形的白色糖霜线条。断腿残肢和拐杖糖底部附近的地面上散落着细小的棕色饼干屑。

插画以纯白色背景为衬托，角色身后有一抹微妙柔和的淡蓝色水彩晕染，使其更加突出。

插画下方，用黑色、古怪、非正式、全大写的手写字体写着短语 CHEERS TO SURVIVING THE SEASON。

title: Navy Blue Watercolor String Lights
prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas card design with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.

The card features a solid deep navy blue background, creating a night-sky feel. It's decorated with a pattern of multiple horizontal, wavy strings of Christmas lights. The strings themselves are a delicate, thin gold line.

The light bulbs have a charming watercolor texture in festive shades of red, pink, and mint green, arranged alternately along the strings.

In the upper-middle section, the greeting merry christmas is written in an elegant, thin, and flowing gold cursive script.

The overall aesthetic is flat, graphic, and modern with a cozy, hand-painted touch. The design is clean,精美, and high-resolution.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 海军蓝水彩串灯
promptZh:
一张精美可打印的圣诞贺卡设计，宽高比为 1:1.4。

贺卡采用纯深海军蓝色背景，营造出夜空的感觉。卡片上装饰着多条水平波浪形圣诞彩灯串图案。灯串本身是精致纤细的金色线条。

灯泡具有迷人的水彩纹理，采用节日气氛的红色、粉色和薄荷绿色调，沿灯串交替排列。

在卡片中上部，贺词 merry christmas 以优雅、纤细、流畅的金色草书书写。

整体美学风格扁平、图形化、现代，并带有一丝温馨的手绘感。设计简洁、精美且高分辨率。

title: Symmetrical Folk Art Reindeer
prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas card design in a whimsical folk art style, gouache illustration.

The design is perfectly symmetrical on a clean white background. In the center, two charming light-beige reindeer with grey antlers face each other nose-to-nose. They each wear a festive red harness or sweater with white striped patterns.

The reindeer are surrounded by a dense and beautiful pattern of winter botanicals, including dark green holly with red berries, a stylized fir tree, olive green leaves, and mint green foliage. Stylized red poinsettia flowers are scattered throughout.

The entire aesthetic is flat 2D, with a hand-painted texture and a classic festive color palette of red, green, and white.

High detail, charming and heartwarming, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 对称民间艺术驯鹿
promptZh:
一张精致的、可打印的圣诞贺卡设计，采用异想天开的民间艺术风格，水粉插画。

设计在干净的白色背景上完美对称。中央是两只迷人的浅米色驯鹿，长着灰色鹿角，鼻尖相对。它们各自穿着一件带有白色条纹图案的节日红色挽具或毛衣。

驯鹿被密集而美丽的冬季植物图案环绕，包括深绿色的带红浆果的冬青、一棵风格化的冷杉树、橄榄绿色的叶子和薄荷绿色的枝叶。风格化的红色一品红花朵散布其间。

整体美学是扁平的 2D 风格，具有手绘纹理和经典的节日调色板，由红色、绿色和白色组成。

高细节，迷人而温馨，长宽比为 1:1.4。

title: Navy Blue and Silver Glitter Snowflakes
prompt:
An elegant and festive holiday greeting card design, presented in a flat, frontal view. The background is a rich, deep navy blue with subtle, darker blue tonal swirls creating a sense of depth. A beautiful arrangement of intricate snowflakes in shimmering silver glitter and polished metallic gold are scattered across the design. These elements have a raised, embossed foil texture that makes them pop.

A very large, highly detailed silver glitter snowflake serves as the central focal point, slightly above the middle. Other gold and silver snowflakes of varying sizes and designs, along with graceful swirls and delicate dotted trails, are artfully scattered, creating a magical sense of movement.

At the bottom right, the greeting 'Happy Holidays' is rendered in a classy, embossed gold font.

This is a high-resolution, printable graphic illustration with sharp, clean details and studio lighting that accentuates the metallic and glitter textures. --ar 1:1.4
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 海军蓝和银色闪光雪花
promptZh:
一张优雅而充满节日气氛的贺卡设计，以平面正面视角呈现。背景是浓郁的深海军蓝色，带有微妙的深蓝色漩涡纹理，营造出一种深度感。设计中散布着精美的雪花图案，采用闪亮的银色亮片和抛光的金属金色，这些元素具有凸起的压纹烫金质感，使其跃然纸上。

一张非常大、细节丰富的银色亮片雪花作为视觉中心，位于略高于中间的位置。其他金色和银色的雪花，大小和设计各异，以及优雅的漩涡和精致的点状轨迹，巧妙地散布其间，营造出一种神奇的动感。

在右下角，祝福语“Happy Holidays”以典雅的压纹金色字体呈现。

这是一张高分辨率、可打印的图形插画，具有清晰锐利的细节和影棚灯光效果，突出了金属和亮片的质感。--ar 1:1.4

title: Classic Painterly Santa and Woodland Animals
prompt:
An exquisite, highly detailed printable Christmas illustration in a classic painterly style. A jolly Santa Claus, dressed in his traditional red suit with white fur trim, stands in a snowy forest clearing at night, smiling as he reads from a long parchment scroll.

To his left is a beautifully decorated Christmas tree, its branches laden with snow, colorful baubles, and lights, topped with a glowing star that illuminates the scene. Several wrapped presents in red, blue, and gold paper are nestled at the base of the tree. Behind Santa, his large green toy sack rests in the snow.

In the foreground, a vintage lantern casts a warm, golden glow on the snow, where a charming group of woodland creatures have gathered. Two curious squirrels, two fluffy rabbits, and several small birds watch Santa with wonder.

Gentle snowflakes fall through the air, blanketing the entire scene. In the distant background, a quaint village with a church steeple is visible among the snow-covered pine trees, all under a deep blue winter night sky. The artwork has a magical, heartwarming atmosphere, with a beautiful interplay of warm and cool light and rich textures.

--ar 1:1.4
author: Jared Liu
titleZh: 经典油画风格圣诞老人与森林动物
promptZh:
一幅精致、细节丰富的可打印圣诞插画，采用经典的绘画风格。一位身着传统红白毛边圣诞服的慈祥圣诞老人，在夜晚的雪地林间空地上，微笑着阅读着一卷长长的羊皮纸。
